from pathlib import Path
p = Path('tasks/t0097_multi_obj_optim/assets/paper/10.3389_fninf.2016.00017/summary.md')
content = p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
# Replace plain country codes in metadata authors with flag emojis
old_metadata = '* **Authors**: Werner Van Geit CH, Michael Gevaert CH, Giuseppe Chindemi CH, Christian Rossert CH,\n  Jean-Denis Courcol CH, Eilif B. Muller CH, Felix Schurmann CH, Idan Segev IL,\n  Henry Markram CH'
new_metadata = '* **Authors**: Werner Van Geit \U0001F1E8\U0001F1ED, Michael Gevaert \U0001F1E8\U0001F1ED, Giuseppe Chindemi \U0001F1E8\U0001F1ED, Christian Rössert \U0001F1E8\U0001F1ED,\n  Jean-Denis Courcol \U0001F1E8\U0001F1ED, Eilif B. Muller \U0001F1E8\U0001F1ED, Felix Schürmann \U0001F1E8\U0001F1ED, Idan Segev \U0001F1EE\U0001F1F1,\n  Henry Markram \U0001F1E8\U0001F1ED'
assert old_metadata in content, 'old metadata block not found'
content = content.replace(old_metadata, new_metadata)
# fix Schmuecker -> Schmücker
content = content.replace('Schmuecker', 'Schmücker')
# fix delta-t -> Greek Delta t
content = content.replace('delta-t = -50 ms', 'Δt = -50 ms').replace('delta-t = +10 ms', 'Δt = +10 ms')
# fix micrometres -> µm
content = content.replace('660 micrometres and 800 micrometres', '660 µm and 800 µm')
p.write_text(content, encoding='utf-8')
print('done. size:', p.stat().st_size)
